notes.title: Normal Feature Update
notes.notes:
The Background Space and window sizes to better fit the 1920x180 space
 Some default walls have had their colours changed to not be so pale
 The spacebar will now forcibly hide all UI so you may click where the option menus are
 The M button now hides both the mouse and it's crosshair
 Some framework stuff is being done to improve background performance 


We appreciate the feedback and look forward to give you an amazing major update soon featuring twitch integration!
